name: DWH Projection Consumer
purpose: consume named DWH projections without coupling WebEngine to DWH storage, PHP implementation or relation internals
rules: WebEngine calls DWH by semantic symbol
DWH projection responses must identify the symbol they satisfy
storage tables, joins, PHP classes and persistence backend are outside WebEngine semantics
WebEngine does not invent fallback projections when DWH resolution fails
#SITE and #METAMODULE:CATALOG are contracted DWH projections consumed by WebEngine
case-sensitive symbol suffixes are preserved exactly

http.rule: HTTP transport is consumer plumbing only and does not define symbol semantics
